## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at Route de Guérard.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Parrot World is an immersive animal park located 10 km from Disneyland Paris and only 30 minutes from Paris, dedicated to the treasures of South America. Visitors can observe animals from the Amazon and Patagonia in a setting close to their natural habitat.
>
> The park is designed like a nature reserve where visitors can search for iconic South American animals such as parrots, jaguars, giant otters, Humboldt penguins, capybaras, and many others.
>
> In addition to the animal exhibits, there are also dining options and a large playground for children. The park offers a fun and immersive experience where visitors can be transported to the colorful landscapes of South America.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.38. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 140 ratings and 71 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
